subject.title: CI: scope pull-request Node tests to affected targets

question: Does the fallback policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106633 preserve enough pull-request coverage to replace the 14-job compact Node plan for precise changes?
rationale: Reducing default pull-request test coverage is an intentional CI policy tradeoff: source inspection can verify the implementation shape, but only the CI owner can accept the residual under-selection risk and runner-capacity tradeoff.

options.title: Approve conservative targeting
options.body: Review and land the linked PR if its merged-tree resolver, target cap, planner-error handling, and broad-impact fallbacks cover all known uncertain paths.

options.title: Retain full PR coverage
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue if any reduction in default pull-request Node coverage is unacceptable despite the capacity savings.

recommendation.title: Approve conservative targeting
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR if its merged-tree resolver, target cap, planner-error handling, and broad-impact fallbacks cover all known uncertain paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored both the requested CI policy and its linked implementation, making them the strongest available owner for the coverage tradeoff.
